verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is driven through programmatic SDKs (Python, JS, Go) and a CLI. Nothing in the pack shows a first-party natural-language interface for operating the product, such as a chat assistant, NL command mode, or official MCP server. The agent example and llms.txt show users building their own agents on top of sandboxes or feeding docs to LLMs, which is not the same as operating Modal itself with natural-language commands.
